title: LanPolicy v1 — the real-LAN deployment discipline as data: the named required_nodes must all stand on the wire together; carriage is TLS only (transport is always tls, plaintext_allowed always false) at a TLS 1.3 floor (minimum_tls_version is always TLSv1.3); discovery is unaided — cloud_rendezvous is always false and the only roads in are the operator's seed list and mDNS announcements (discovery_roads) — a policy naming weaker discipline fails validation (Y-062)
